dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: I'm sorry! My shift ran late, and then I had to finish an assignment.

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: Nothing. You're just never around anymore.

dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: I took on extra shifts, because I thought the extra money would help.

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: I don't care about the money! I care about you actually spending time with me! Isn't spending time with me important to you?

dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: I do spend time with you…

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: When? When was the last time you spent time with me.

dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: That's not fair. You said you were stressed about money, so now I'm trying to help out…

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: I want you to spend time with me. It's not a relationship if you don't spend time with me. I make time to spend with you. You need to do the same. It's not okay for you to always be out of the house or working on something. You also don't help around the house anymore. Am I just an ATM to you?

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: You make me so angry sometimes. I'm going to bed.

glossary.label: Exhaustion as control
glossary.body: Overworking a victim creates chronic physiological burnout. Combined with double standards and guilt-trips ("you're never around"), the victim is left physically drained, confused, and without the mental energy needed to recognize the manipulation or plan an exit.

steps.quote: You also don't help around the house anymore.
Isn't spending time with me important to you?
Am I just an ATM to you?

glossary.note: Mango asked for help with money, then got angry when Violet worked more to help.
